rendered.subject: Collaboration Opportunity for Instagram
rendered.body:
Hi Fly By Jing team,

We’re a small team dedicated to crafting engaging Instagram content that helps brands connect with their audiences. We’d like to propose a collaborative Instagram post built on the fact that Fly By Jing has identified the importance of partnering with other brands as a key component of its community-building strategy [P3]. You’ve also noted that this approach has provided a significant advantage in the early stages of CPG product launches, specifically through the use of pre-existing demand signals. Furthermore, founder Jing Gao shared that the brand experienced challenges during the coronavirus pandemic, which they learned from and incorporated into its marketing approach. This post would showcase a collaborative Instagram concept that builds on that foundation, featuring a post that highlights the partnership with Fly By Jing and their community-building strategy, inspired by your insights [P3]. It would be a way to further demonstrate your commitment to strategic marketing and build on your past successes together.

The BrandPilot team
